title: Turning down Duke Ellington's offers
summary: Ellington asked him to join many times and Holmes always refused, though the band was his favorite, because he lacked the desire to join the best.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Well, you actually got to know Duke Ellington very well, then.
Oh yeah. I won't tell you how many times I refused to work in his band. I won't tell you tonight.
I think you told me once. Eleven or seventeen times...
Eleven times he asked you to join, and eleven times you turned him down.
Not that I had anything against him.
And at the same time, you told me also that Duke Ellington was your favorite man.

That was my favorite band. It sure was. That's why I didn't want to work with him. Yeah. No, I loved to listen to the band. I was crazy about it. I never wanted to work in it. You know, you have to have a desire to be with something. I don't know why I desired to be with something not so good... You know, people have funny ideas. They know it's not as good, but you don't want to be with the best. One of them things, you know.
